description.en: A shooting-arm illustration adapted to your projected arm lengths and release direction. It shows the idea of comfortable extension and briefly retaining a finish. It is not a measured expert pose or a universal correct angle.
description.zh: 按你的画面臂长和这球的出手方向，示意舒适伸展、稍留收势的教学目标。它不是实测的球星姿态，也不规定所有人相同的正确角度。

teach_target_basis.en: The sources support qualitative extension and follow-through cues. The geometry, angle and display duration below are product illustration choices, not values prescribed or validated by those sources. Only the shooting arm is drawn; body balance and hand/finger relaxation are not synthesized.
teach_target_basis.zh: 来源支持伸展与随挥的定性教学提示。下列几何形状、角度和显示时段是产品的示意选择，并非来源规定或验证的标准。只绘制出手臂，不合成全身平衡、手腕或手指的放松姿态。

angle_policy: Use at least the illustrative angle, retaining a more extended observed release when present; never grade a shot by this angle or force elbow lockout.
display_window_policy: The overlay window is for review only, not a required hold duration.
adaptation: Median visible projected upper-arm/forearm lengths and shoulder-to-wrist direction near this shot's release; anchor at the visible current shooting shoulder. No whole-body ideal and no copied celebrity motion.
